movies.overview: George Bailey has spent his entire life giving to the people of Bedford Falls.  All that prevents rich skinflint Mr. Potter from taking over the entire town is George's modest building and loan company.  But on Christmas Eve the business's $8,000 is lost and George's troubles begin.
movies.title: It's a Wonderful Life
movies.tagline: It's a wonderful laugh! It's a wonderful love!

movies.overview: In order to help bring Nazis to justice, U.S. government agent T.R. Devlin recruits Alicia Huberman, the American daughter of a convicted German war criminal, as a spy. As they begin to fall for one another, Alicia is instructed to win the affections of Alexander Sebastian, a Nazi hiding out in Brazil. When Sebastian becomes serious about his relationship with Alicia, the stakes get higher, and Devlin must watch her slip further undercover.
movies.title: Notorious
movies.tagline: Deep their love! Great the risk!

movies.overview: The story of a gentle-hearted beast in love with a simple and beautiful girl. She is drawn to the repellent but strangely fascinating Beast, who tests her fidelity by giving her a key, telling her that if she doesn't return it to him by a specific time, he will die of grief. She is unable to return the key on time, but it is revealed that the Beast is the genuinely handsome one. A simple tale of tragic love that turns into a surreal vision of death, desire, and beauty.
movies.title: Beauty and the Beast
movies.tagline: Once upon a time…

movies.overview: Three brothers stop off for a night in the town of Tombstone. The next morning they find one of their brothers dead and their cattle stolen. They decide to take revenge on the culprits.
movies.title: My Darling Clementine
movies.tagline: She was everything the West was - young, fiery, exciting!

movies.overview: Private Investigator Philip Marlowe is hired by wealthy General Sternwood regarding a matter involving his youngest daughter Carmen. Before the complex case is over, Marlowe sees murder, blackmail, deception, and what might be love.
movies.title: The Big Sleep
movies.tagline: The picture they were born for!

movies.overview: A gambler discovers an old flame while in Argentina, but she's married to his new boss.
movies.title: Gilda
movies.tagline: There NEVER was a woman like Gilda!

movies.overview: Two hit men walk into a diner asking for a man called "the Swede". When the killers find the Swede, he's expecting them and doesn't put up a fight. Since the Swede had a life insurance policy, an investigator, on a hunch, decides to look into the murder. As the Swede's past is laid bare, it comes to light that he was in love with a beautiful woman who may have lured him into pulling off a bank robbery overseen by another man.
movies.title: The Killers
movies.tagline: She's a match for any mobster!

movies.overview: An investigator from the War Crimes Commission travels to Connecticut to find an infamous Nazi, who may be hiding out in a small town in the guise of a distinguished professor engaged to the Supreme Court Justice’s daughter.
movies.title: The Stranger
movies.tagline: The most deceitful man a woman ever loved!

movies.original_title: The Best Years of Our Lives
movies.overview: It's the hope that sustains the spirit of every GI: the dream of the day when he will finally return home. For three WWII veterans, the day has arrived. But for each man, the dream is about to become a nightmare.
movies.title: The Best Years of Our Lives
movies.tagline: Three wonderful loves in the best picture of the year!

movies.original_title: A Matter of Life and Death
movies.overview: A British wartime aviator who cheats death must argue for his life before a celestial court, hoping to prolong his fledgling romance with an American girl.
movies.title: A Matter of Life and Death
movies.tagline: Neither Heaven nor Earth could keep them apart!

movies.overview: Amateur plumber Cluny Brown gets sent off by her uncle to work as a servant at an English country estate.
movies.title: Cluny Brown
movies.tagline: At Last...The Stars You've Wanted - In Each Other's Arms!

movies.overview: Proud, eccentric, and antisocial, Monsieur Hire has always kept to himself. But after a woman turns up dead in the Paris suburb where he lives, he feels drawn to a pretty young newcomer to town and discovers that his neighbors are only too ready to suspect the worst of him.
movies.title: Panic

movies.overview: Beautiful half-breed Pearl Chavez becomes the ward of her dead father's first love and finds herself torn between her sons, one good and the other bad.
movies.title: Duel in the Sun
movies.tagline: Emotions . . . As Violent As The Wind-Swept Prairie !

movies.overview: A married woman and a drifter fall in love, then plot to murder her husband.
movies.title: The Postman Always Rings Twice
movies.tagline: Their Love was a Flame that Destroyed!

movies.overview: In this Dickens adaptation, orphan Pip discovers through lawyer Mr. Jaggers that a mysterious benefactor wishes to ensure that he becomes a gentleman. Reunited with his childhood patron, Miss Havisham, and his first love, the beautiful but emotionally cold Estella, he discovers that the elderly spinster has gone mad from having been left at the altar as a young woman, and has made her charge into a warped, unfeeling heartbreaker.
movies.title: Great Expectations
movies.tagline: From the Vivid Pages of Charles Dickens' Masterpiece!

movies.overview: A dramatized account of the French Resistance, this wartime film depicts how railway workers sabotaged German trains to disrupt troop movements and supply lines during the Nazi occupation. Blending documentary realism with fiction, it pays tribute to the courage and sacrifice of ordinary workers who became central to the fight for liberation.
movies.title: The Battle of the Rails

movies.overview: Six stories unfold in various regions, from Sicily to the northern Po Valley as American military personnel interact with a variety of Italian locals over eighteen months in the push north during the Italian Campaign of WWII as German forces retreat.
movies.title: Paisan
movies.tagline: There are always opportunities for redemption.

movies.overview: Two shoeshine boys in postwar Rome, Italy save up to buy a horse, but their involvement as dupes in a burglary lands them in juvenile prison; the experience take a devastating toll on their friendship.
movies.title: Shoeshine

movies.overview: A simple Connecticut farm girl is recruited by a distant relative, an aristocratic patroon, to be governess to his young daughter in his Hudson Valley mansion.
movies.title: Dragonwyck
movies.tagline: Secret thoughts... That led to secret love... That led to rapture and terror!

movies.overview: In post-Liberation Paris, a man reunites with a friend and meets the woman of his dreams, only to discover her brother's dark past.
movies.title: Gates of the Night

movies.overview: A ballet producer returns to his native town and schemes to avenge himself on the family who tried to murder him 20 years before.
movies.title: Un revenant

movies.overview: The Marx Brothers are employed at a hotel in postwar Casablanca, where a ring of Nazis is trying to recover a cache of stolen treasure.
movies.title: A Night in Casablanca
movies.tagline: 100 Girls! 1,000 Scenes! 10,000 Laffs!

movies.overview: In 1850s Oregon, a businessman is torn between his love of two very different women and his loyalty to a compulsive gambler friend who goes over the line.
movies.title: Canyon Passage
movies.tagline: Every Exciting Character! Every Dangerous Moment....

movies.overview: After returning from a concentration camp, Susanne finds a traumatized ex-soldier living in her apartment in bombed out Berlin. Together the two try to move past their experiences during WWII.
movies.title: The Murderers Are Among Us

movies.overview: After her anti-fascist professor father is dismissed, Yukie navigates love, political repression, and wartime upheaval—ultimately forging her own path in pre- and post-WWII Japan.
movies.title: No Regrets for Our Youth

movies.original_title: The Strange Love of Martha Ivers
movies.overview: Three childhood friends, Martha, Walter and Sam, share a terrible secret. Over time, the ambitious Martha and the pusillanimous Walter have married. She is a cold businesswoman; he is the district attorney: a perfect combination to dominate the corrupt city of Iverstown at will. But the unexpected return of Sam, after years of absence, deeply disturbs the life of the odd couple.
movies.title: The Strange Love of Martha Ivers
movies.tagline: Fate drew them together… and only murder could part them!

movies.overview: In the tradition of Fantasia, Make Mine Music is a glorious collection of musically charged animated shorts featuring such fun-filled favorites as "Peter and the Wolf", narrated by the beloved voice behind Winnie the Pooh. In addition you'll enjoy such classic cartoon hits as "Casey at the Bat," "The Whale Who Wanted to Sing at the Met" and "Johnnie Fedora and Alice Bluebonnet."
movies.title: Make Mine Music
movies.tagline: Happy Comedy Musical

movies.overview: Disney's animated adaptation of Prokofiev's masterpiece, in which every character is represented musically by a different instrument. Young Peter decides to go hunting for the wolf that's been prowling around the village. Along the way, he is joined by his friends the bird, the duck and the cat. All the fun comes to end, however, when the wolf makes an appearance. Will Peter and his friends live to tell of their adventures?
movies.title: Peter and the Wolf

movies.overview: A minister falls in love with a blind young woman he sheltered, but so does his son.
movies.title: Pastoral Symphony

movies.overview: Uncle Remus draws upon his tales of Br'er Rabbit to help little Johnny deal with his confusion over his parents' separation as well as his new life on the plantation.
movies.title: Song of the South
movies.tagline: Here Comes the Zip-A-Dee-Doo-Dah Show!

movies.overview: A sister and her disturbed twin are implicated in a murder and a police detective must figure out which one's the killer.
movies.title: The Dark Mirror
movies.tagline: Twins! One who loves... one who loves to Kill!

movies.overview: Mickey and Donald take a truckload of mouse boys on a picnic. The boys delight in tormenting Donald, first by filching the picnic food, then giving him a flower with a bee inside (Donald eventually gets the whole hive after him), and finally a sandwich with another bee in it.
movies.title: Orphan's Picnic

movies.overview: Newspaper magnate Charles Foster Kane is taken from his mother as a boy and made the ward of a rich industrialist. As a result, every well-meaning, tyrannical or self-destructive move he makes for the rest of his life appears in some way to be a reaction to that deeply wounding event.
movies.title: Citizen Kane
movies.tagline: Some called him a hero...others called him a heel.

movies.overview: This character study of a French patriot during the Nazi Occupation has comedian Noel as the chief of the underground who uses his hobby of growing orchids to hide his radio equipment.
movies.title: Mr. Orchid

movies.original_title: 歌麿をめぐる五人の女
movies.overview: Utamaro, a great artist, lives to create portraits of beautiful women, and the brothels of Tokyo provide his models. A world of passion swirls around him, as the women in his life vie for lovers. And, occasionally, his art gets him into trouble.
movies.title: Utamaro and His Five Women

movies.overview: The local building-contractor Martin Roumagnac is fascinated by the fashionable Blanche Ferrand. To impress Blache, Martin presents her with a villa. However, this ruins him financially. Despite Martin's many efforts for the now femme-fatal Blanche, she is not able to chose between him and the rich consul De Laubry.
movies.title: Martin Roumagnac

movies.overview: The spoiled young heir to the decaying Amberson fortune comes between his widowed mother and the man she has always loved.
movies.title: The Magnificent Ambersons
movies.tagline: Real life screened more daringly than it’s ever been before!

movies.original_title: Иван Грозный. Сказ второй: Боярский заговор
movies.overview: This is the second part of a projected three-part epic biopic of Russian Czar Ivan Grozny, undertaken by Soviet film-maker Sergei Eisenstein at the behest of Josef Stalin.  Production of the epic was stopped before the third part could be filmed, due to producer dissatisfaction with Eisenstein's introducing forbidden experimental filming techniques into the material, more evident in this part than the first part.  As it was, this second part was banned from showings until after the deaths of both Eisenstein and Stalin, and a change of attitude by the subsequent heads of the Soviet government.  In this part, as Ivan the Terrible attempts to consolidate his power by establishing a personal army, his political rivals, the Russian boyars, plot to assassinate him.
movies.title: Ivan the Terrible, Part II: The Boyars' Plot

movies.overview: Mortimer Brewster, a newspaper drama critic, playwright, and author known for his diatribes against marriage, suddenly falls in love and gets married;  but when he makes a quick trip home to tell his two maiden aunts, he finds out his aunts' hobby - killing lonely old men and burying them in the cellar!
movies.title: Arsenic and Old Lace
movies.tagline: She Passed Out On Cary! No Wonder . . . She's just discovered his favorite aunts have poisoned their 13th gentleman friend!

movies.overview: A sheltered heiress falls for a charming playboy and elopes with him, but soon discovers his gambling vice and mounting debts. As his lies deepen and those around them meet mysterious ends, she begins to suspect that her husband’s affection may conceal a deadly motive—and that she could be his next victim.
movies.title: Suspicion
movies.tagline: In his arms she felt safety...in his absence, haunting dread!

movies.overview: Italian partisans help a professor sent by the OSS to find an atomic scientist held by Nazis.
movies.title: Cloak and Dagger
movies.tagline: The moment he fell in love was his moment of greatest danger!

movies.overview: During the Nazi occupation of 1944 Rome, Resistance leader Giorgio Manfredi is pursued by the Nazis as he seeks refuge and a means of escape.
movies.title: Rome, Open City
movies.tagline: Our battle has barely begun.

movies.overview: The wolf escapes from Alka-Fizz prison, but persistent Sergeant McPoodle (Droopy) of the Canadian Mounties follows his trail wherever he goes.
movies.title: Northwest Hounded Police

movies.overview: On a stormy night, the mute servant to an ailing matriarch is stalked by a serial killer.
movies.title: The Spiral Staircase
movies.tagline: Conflicts that freeze your emotions! Suspense that takes your breath!

movies.overview: George Taylor returns from WWII with amnesia. Back home in Los Angeles, while trying to track down his old identity, he stumbles onto a three year old murder case and a hunt for a missing $2 million.
movies.title: Somewhere in the Night
movies.tagline: Somewhere in his mind!

movies.overview: Soon after a veteran returns from war, his cheating wife is found dead. He evades police in an attempt to find the real murderer.
movies.title: The Blue Dahlia
movies.tagline: Double dame trouble! Double-barrelled action!

movies.overview: Holmes and Watson board a passenger train bound from London to Edinburgh, to guard the Star of Rhodesia, an enormous diamond worth a fortune belonging to an elderly woman of wealth; but within the first hour of the trip, the woman's son is murdered and the diamond stolen and any of the passengers in their car could be the killer thief.
movies.title: Terror by Night
movies.tagline: One way ticket to DEATH..!

movies.overview: After a rapid engagement, a dowdy daughter of a chemist weds an industrialist, knowing little of his family or past. He transforms her into an elegant society wife, but becomes enraged whenever she asks about Michael, his mysterious long-lost brother.
movies.title: Undercurrent
movies.tagline: An Irresistible Force That Draws a Man and Woman Together!

movies.overview: A teenager becomes fixated on a painting of the handsome suitor who died in a duel for her grandmother's love. On her sixteenth birthday, her father hires three men who pretend to be the ghost of the suitor to entertain her. Little do they know, the ghost of the suitor himself is roaming the castle halls.
movies.title: Sylvia and the Ghost

movies.overview: Walt Disney's timeless masterpiece is an extravaganza of sight and sound! See the music come to life, hear the pictures burst into song and experience the excitement that is Fantasia over and over again.
movies.title: Fantasia
movies.tagline: The most sensational sound you'll ever see!
